remarks: Lovely 2 bedroom 1 bathroom in desirable Brookside Neighborhood only 1 mile from charming Rowayton with coffee shops, banking, parks, etc... Centrally located to both Rowayton and Darien train stations making for an easy commute.   All new appliances, lots of extra storage in a partially finished basement. plenty of on street and off street parking, use of the private large back yard, and access to Norwalk beaches.  Included is trash/recycling, snow removal, landscaping, and water.  Professionally managed and available 24/7 for any calls or maintenance issues.  Wont last, apply now!
